verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is a SaaS invoicing service, so an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions one. The REST API with OAuth is a developer building block that could be used to construct an agent integration, not an official MCP server, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
